authority: User instruction to complete partial packs, extend the API where needed, or formally reject remaining purposes

decisions.purpose: Distinguish native missing, empty and subdirectory-only directory states
decisions.reason: The admitted public catalogue describes files, and current list/exists/resolve observations collapse these native directory states. Guessing an error or reading ambient host paths would fabricate parity. A separate managed directory model would be required to preserve that exact legacy distinction.
decisions.supported_purpose: Load images from a selected admitted prefix containing files; preserve lexical ordering, islice semantics, decoded pixels/masks and finite selection bounds.
decisions.acceptance: Record missing/empty/subdirectory cases as explicit unsupported-purpose observations, with zero ordinary error/return parity credit. No public directory-exists API is claimed.

decisions.purpose: Return or select ambient absolute host paths and reproduce their exact path text
decisions.reason: Managed assets expose admitted logical names or host-issued descriptors. Ambient absolute path selection, native server paths and exact path-bearing messages have no granted host-path authority.
decisions.supported_purpose: Select, decode, save or pass managed assets using logical names and owned descriptors.
decisions.acceptance: Test actual downstream managed-asset consumers. Label path/name projection explicitly; never call the changed path string exact native parity.

decisions.purpose: Echo arbitrary unchecked strings directly as browser media URLs
decisions.reason: The current preview boundary uses admitted media and host-issued descriptors, rather than arbitrary browser URL authority.
decisions.supported_purpose: Preview admitted media through the existing owned media token and frontend redemption flow.
decisions.acceptance: Qualify actual valid media and descriptor redemption. Preserve explicit invalid-input/provider refusal diagnostics instead of claiming unchecked-string parity.

decisions.purpose: Write metadata beyond the public PNG keyword/size bounds or reproduce non-atomic host filesystem failure side effects
decisions.reason: The existing public save operation deliberately constrains PNG keywords and payload size and uses managed output publication. These are concrete policy/side-effect differences, not absent PNG save support.
decisions.supported_purpose: Save bounded valid PNG metadata and pixels with exact admitted filename, codec and overwrite parameters.
decisions.acceptance: Keep native PngInfo validation before publication where representable. Report invalid, oversized and failure-side-effect cases separately; no success or exact parity credit for refused domains.

HTTP_authority: HTTP/HTTPS permission already authorized by the user. Native and Guest component evidence exists. Signed pack identity/provider admission and node-level tests remain separate, with no repeated consent request.
remaining_runtime_gates: Actual catalogue/media/codec/EXIF/MPO/animation/OSS/downstream fixtures, normal manifest generation after runtime deltas, typed Guest execution and deployment admission. Those are not new SDK feature requirements without concrete source evidence.
canonical_status_owner: Conversion service; this coordination decision is not a pack-written status sidecar
